entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is completely unacceptable. I bought a jersey from you people and it's useless. I want to return it right now. This is the worst service I've ever had.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having a bad experience, sir. I can certainly look into this for you. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

The issue is it doesn't fit! It's the wrong size entirely. Your website's sizing chart is a complete lie. This thing is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. I want an exchange or my money back, and if I don't get it, everyone is going to hear about this online.
I understand your frustration completely, and I want to help resolve this. It sounds like a sizing issue rather than a defect with the item itself, is that correct?
Obviously! It's not torn, it's just made for a child. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I'm confident I can resolve this for you, sir. I just need to pull up your order. Could I please have your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Fine. It's mark.stevens@email.com. Just hurry up.

Thank you, Mark. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Aero Pro jersey, delivered 54 days ago. I've reviewed your order, and since it is a standard apparel item, it is well within our 90-day return window.
Yes, absolutely. I can process an immediate exchange for the correct size or a full refund to your original payment method. Whichever you prefer.
Oh. Okay. Well, good. I want a refund then. I'll just order the right one myself.

Not a problem at all. I have just initiated that refund for you and sent a prepaid return label to your email on file. Just package the jersey and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Alright, that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
